licenses.text:
Tungarar Jehobald YARILDEWALLIN, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/nay/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/nay/copyright.htm):
> Extracts from the Holy Bible in the Narriyeri language of Australia
> Public Domain
> Language: Ngarrindjeri (Narrinyeri)
> 2019-05-24

Why this is public domain:
Translator: George Taplin, 1831-1879, credited on the title page. Text: extracts from Genesis, Exodus, Matthew and John, published in 1864 in South Australia (reprinted 1926). US: published before 1931. Australia: life plus 70 years ended in 1949.

The verse-per-line archive holds the Bible text in one file, one verse per line, each line starting with its reference (book, chapter:verse); its SQL and XML copies of the same text, eBible.org's description page, style sheet and signature are left out of the source.

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=nay), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/nay/copyright.htm), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Taplin; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_countries%27_copyright_lengths; https://copyright.cornell.edu/publicdomain.

note: The verse-numbered twin of ebible-nay-83a24e61, for the parallel verses measure only (#35): its tag is verse-numbers alone, which no mixture selects, so it never enters training. eBible.org rebuilds this zip often; the checksum covers the files inside.
